memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- NAFLD
  - Status: newly diagnosed, asymptomatic, ALT 68 U/L, AST 55 U/L, LDL 130 mg/dL, triglycerides 180 mg/dL, platelets 210×10⁹/L.
  - Plan: Start silymarin 140 mg TDS, rosuvastatin 5 mg OD, advise reduced refined carbohydrates and 30‑minute brisk walk daily; review in 3 months.
- Insomnia
  - Status: difficulty falling asleep, ISI score 18 (moderate), no daytime fatigue reported.
  - Plan: Start melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS, sleep hygiene counseling; reassess in 4 weeks.
- Migraine prophylaxis
  - Status: 4‑5 migraine days/month, on no preventive.
  - Plan: Start propranolol 40 mg OD, sumatriptan 50 mg SOS for acute, topiramate 25 mg HS, naproxen 500 mg SOS; headache diary.
Due: HbA1c repeat 2025-07-05.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- NAFLD
  - Status: improved, ALT 52 U/L, AST 44 U/L, LDL 115 mg/dL, triglycerides 150 mg/dL, weight 68 kg, waist 88 cm (men ≤90).
  - Plan: Continue silymarin 140 mg TDS, increase rosuvastatin to 10 mg OD, maintain diet, add weekly yoga.
- Insomnia
  - Status: ISI score 12 (mild), reports occasional mid‑night awakening.
  - Plan: Continue melatonin 3 mg HS, reduce trazodone to 25 mg HS, continue sleep hygiene.
- Migraine
  - Status: 2‑3 migraine days/month, using sumatriptan ≤2×/week.
  - Plan: Continue propranolol 40 mg OD, topiramate 25 mg HS, naproxen SOS; advise trigger avoidance.
Due: HbA1c repeat 2025-10-10.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Neurological examination: No focal deficits, normal gait, negative Romberg. Migraine features consistent with episodic migraine without aura. No signs of increased intracranial pressure.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I feel my sleep is much better now – falling asleep within 20 minutes and waking refreshed. Migraines are rare, only one mild episode last month treated with sumatriptan. No side effects from medicines.
